title: Recursive Language Models: An All-in-One Deep Dive
author: Avishek Biswas
summary: Recursive Language Models (RLMs) use a special way to call LLMs that lets them handle long tasks by breaking them into smaller parts. They run code in a shared Python environment, which helps them remember past results without loading everything into the LLM’s context. This method allows RLMs to solve big problems efficiently without being limited by the LLM’s context size.
